With only 3 validation windows, unstable rankings (Kendall tau 0.127), and high error correlation (0.861), the robust median over the full pool is already capturing the benefit of diversification without overfitting to noisy window-specific rankings. action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality with unstable model rankings (Kendall tau 0.127) and high inter-model error correlation (0.861, only 5 independent groups). The full-pool median is the most robust combination: it avoids overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows, benefits from the 19 models' complementary errors, and is insensitive to the few outlying models. The runner-up (trimmed_mean pool3) is statistically indistinguishable, and smaller pools or fitted weights perform worse, confirming that broad robust averaging is the right strategy for this regime.
